title: Kirak agent
description: One agent, defined in a JSON file in the project's agents/ directory. Kirak loads every file there at startup and adds run, resume and metadata endpoints for each agent. Python function tools are registered in code with @kirak.agent("<name>").tool, not here.

$schema.description: Points editors at this schema. Kirak ignores it when loading.

name.description: Agent name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter. Used in the agent's routes and in @kirak.agent("<name>"). Must be unique.

x-kirak-errors.pattern: 'name' must be lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, starting with a letter.

description.description: What the agent does. Shown in the GET /ai/agents listing.

model.description: pydantic-ai model as "provider:name". The provider's pip extra must be installed (e.g. kirak[ai-openai]).

instructions.description: System prompt. Either this or instructions_file is required.

instructions_file.description: Path of a text or Markdown file holding the system prompt, relative to this agent file. YAML frontmatter (--- ... ---) is removed. Used instead of instructions when both are set.

tools.description: Tools the agent may call. Each key is a lowercase ref ("customer.fetch"); each value holds the tool options. Default {}.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema the request body of the agent's run endpoint is validated against before the model is called. Default {} (no check).

output_schema.description: Dotted import path of a Pydantic class the agent's output must match, e.g. "app.schemas.Answer". When set, the output is a validated object instead of text.

conversation.description: Keep message history across calls so a conversation can continue. Default true.

max_turns.description: Maximum model turns in one run before it stops. Default 10.

max_budget_usd.description: Cost cap for one run, in US dollars. Enforced before each LLM turn and after the run; exceeding it raises USAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (429). Default none.

require_tool_use.description: Fail the run when the agent calls no tool. Default false.

access.description: Who may call the agent's endpoints: Guest (anyone, no sign-in), User (any signed-in caller), Admin, or System. Default User.

x-kirak-errors.enum: 'access' must be one of: Admin, Guest, System, User.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Requests per minute allowed to this agent's endpoints. Default 60.

goal_condition.description: Python expression over result / output. When set, the agent runs again (up to max_iterations) until it is true. Needs reviewer_model.

max_iterations.description: Maximum runs while goal_condition is not met. Default 1.

reviewer_model.description: "provider:name" model that scores the output against quality_rubric.

quality_rubric.description: Rubric the reviewer model scores the output against.

quality_threshold.description: Minimum reviewer score, 0 to 3. A lower score fails the run with QUALITY_FAILED. Default 2.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; 0 is the most deterministic. Default: the provider's.

toolsets.description: MCP servers whose tools this agent may call. Each key is a server name (lowercase letters, digits and _). A key with no 'url' names a Kirak-own server (mcp/<name>.json must exist); a key with 'url' names an external server. Auth tokens are environment variables (KIRAK_AI_TOOLSET_{NAME}_TOKEN), never here.

x-kirak-errors.pattern: a toolset key must be lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL of an external MCP server. Omit for a Kirak-own server.
